headlines.text: Rewind to 2021, when The Young Bucks vs. Fenix & PAC put the AEW World Tag Team Titles on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.65 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. It was the first title opportunity of Fenix & PAC's career. A brutal, controversial title defense that later became part of a match fans voted the feud of the entire year ? the Bucks controversially tore off Rey Fenix's mask mid-match before superkicking him for the pin, a heel turn moment that truly shocked the crowd.

It was 2023 when a new chapter began as Aussie Open vs. Best Friends fought for the brand-new IWGP Tag Team Titles, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.72. Aussie Open successfully defended their IWGP Tag Team Titles against Best Friends in their first defense since winning the belts at NJPW's Sakura Genesis just days earlier.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Taya Valkyrie laced up for their first AEW match against Emi Sakura, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.71.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2021, when Darby Allin vs. Matt Hardy fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title in a Falls Count Anywhere match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.01 ? a strong outing. Matt Hardy was challenging for gold for the very first time.
Rewind to 2021, when it was the first-ever encounter between Chris Jericho and Dax Harwood on Dynamite, rated 6.59.
Turning the clock back to 2021: Red Velvet returned to the fold after 6 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.
